text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu*... We're done, right? With 
today's training.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I pushed myself a little too hard. 
I need to rest well to prepare for 
tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good work, Earth. Are you calling it a 
day too?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No, if anything, I'm fired up! Royce-san, 
please do a session with me!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A session... meaning running, right? You 
don't mean right now, do you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Of course, before this flame burns out. 
Royce's run today gave me some intense 
inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"You run, and I pursue. The fugue we play 
together will surely ascend into the most 
exquisite melody!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, a fugue is like a game of tag 
between similar melodies, right? In other 
words, you feel a certain resemblance to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
True, I've felt something similar from 
Earth-san's running before. If running 
together is how I'll understand why—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly it, Trainer! I'm requesting 
extra training!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Two people who seem distinctly different 
at first glance find common ground by 
running together...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"This drama is sure to bring out a whole 
new charm in me!"
choice_data_list: Let's discover a new charm of yours!

Resting is all part of self-producing 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you, Trainer. I'm definitely 
going to make the most of this chance!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now, Earth-san! Let's make this the 
ultimate session, where both our unique 
styles can truly shine!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Put that way, I have no retort.
choice_data_list: Can you keep that Earth under control?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, if I'm to show the 'absolute best 
Royce-chan,' I need to keep myself in 
perfect condition."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Earth-san. Could we reschedule 
our joint training for another day?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Mi dispiace! Still, I cannot force your 
hand. Let us wait for the day our destinos 
cross.
